performance_contract.metric: For each read, the maximum continuous begin, preparation or encode+cache+transport step, then P99/max over 100 reads. Individual stage metrics are also recorded. Fixture setup/invalidation and structural-path assertions are outside the timed steps. Both modes measured separately after compilation, with no concurrent test/build jobs.
performance_contract.allocator: Existing std.testing allocator retained; no affinity/priority pinning, sample removal or threshold relaxation.
performance_contract.preparation: One bounded formatter-stage batch charged against frozen raw source size, at most four completed small Tools or one oversized stage; a large JSON parse is separated from other parses of the same Tool.

performance_interpretation: Current Debug passes all original gates. Current ReleaseFast fails five concentrated-result scenarios. Some worst-step diagnostics have core migration and low thread-cycle counts relative to wall time; no exact OS cause is established. These diagnostics do not override the original wall-clock Gate.
measurement_conditions: Same Windows machine, unpinned threads and unchanged priority, allocator, fixtures and original thresholds. No other repository build/test suite ran during a timed mode. Status/source reads and a short test-file edit/format command overlapped ReleaseFast; their causal effect is unknown. No sample or failed scenario was discarded and no repeat was used to obtain a green result.
limits: Code fixes and functional verification do not close the original wall acceptance Gate. No merge is authorized.
Windows x64 only; no other platform or machine claim.
Loopback scripted services with canonical AgentCore; no real remote image-service acceptance claim.
The desktop pressure test and real image Product test are independent, not one combined desktop image-pressure experiment.
Reading-anchor regression uses mounted TaskContent with deterministic DOM geometry; no pixel-level desktop claim.
No new worker, transport, credential registry, persisted format or event-pump limit change.
